title: Enforce registry allowed_paths during claim
description: Agent registry entries declare allowed_paths but nothing enforces them. During claim, if a registry entry exists for the claiming agent, reject claims whose files_touched_estimate falls outside the agent's allowed_paths (with a clear error). Agents without a registry entry keep current unrestricted behavior in Phase 1.
acceptance_criteria: claim fails when the agent's registry entry exists and the task paths are outside allowed_paths
claim succeeds for agents with no registry entry (unchanged Phase 1 behavior)
test covers both the rejected and permitted cases
